title: Junta Executes Civilian in Sawphya Village Amid Dawei SEZ Land-Clearance Offensive
detail: As the junta's clearance offensive around the Dawei Special Economic Zone continued through August 24, 2026, local resistance sources reported that soldiers executed U Soe Tun, 53, and buried his body at a pagoda in Sawphya Village, Thayetchaung Township, Tanintharyi Region. Thousands of residents from more than ten villages across Thayetchaung, Launglon, and Myitta townships have fled their homes as the junta pushes toward Hteekhee, a KNU Brigade 4-controlled trade zone on the Thai border. The offensive is tied to the military's effort to secure land for the Russia-backed Dawei deep-sea port project.

media.caption: Displacement continues in Dawei District as the junta pushes to clear land for the Dawei SEZ.

title: Junta Airstrike Destroys School Building in Seinnyinwa Village, Paletwa Township
detail: A junta airstrike destroyed a school building in Seinnyinwa Village, Paletwa Township, Chin State, on August 24, 2026. The strike was part of a wider bombardment campaign across Rakhine and Chin states that Burma News International tallied at 33 civilians killed and 78 wounded between August 2-24, with women and children making up the majority of casualties — building on 22 killed and 66 wounded from similar strikes in July.

media.caption: A school building destroyed by a junta airstrike on Seinnyinwa Village, Paletwa Township.
